correctness.rationale: For the explicit equal-moment EMA scalar rule s+=beta s+(1-beta)kappa x, v+=beta v+(1-beta)kappa² x², x+=x-eta |s+|s+/v+, a sign-symmetric orbit must have moments ±kappa c a and constant v=kappa²a², c=(1-beta)/(1+beta), forcing a=eta c²/2. The normalized branch derivative at (1,-c,1) is J+=[[1-8beta,-4beta/c,2beta],[1-beta,beta,0],[2(1-beta),0,beta]], with J-=TJ+T, T=diag(-1,-1,1). Two-step determinant calculation yields the stated cubic and Schur reduction A=1-beta^8, B=a2+beta^4 a1, C=a1+beta^4 a2. The factorizations for A-C, A+C, A±B+C yield strict Schur stability exactly beta²-8beta+1>0, i.e. 0<beta<4-sqrt(15); above it a multiplier leaves the unit disk; at equality the cubic is (z+1)^2(z-beta^4). The local objective gap kappa eta² c^4/8 is positive. No claim about nonlinear stability at boundary, global basins or other cycles.
residual_risks: Finite experiments do not prove unrestricted statements; proof deductions above carry general assertion.

Semantic searches yielded no earlier identical three-state polynomial or cycle frontier. PASS best-of-knowledge with primary-section access limitation.
